description: HAL timing probe: PB13 toggled in SysTick_Handler (500 Hz), PB14 toggled around HAL_Delay(100) (101 ms half period)
expect: 72 MHz, SysTick LOAD 71999 (1 tick = 72000 HCLK cycles = 1.000 ms). PB13 push-pull toggles in every SysTick interrupt: 500 Hz, 1.000 ms high / 1.000 ms low (+-2 us). PB14 push-pull toggles, then HAL_Delay(100), which waits 100 + uwTickFreq = 101 ticks: edges exactly 101 ms apart (+-5 us; the first interval is 100-101 ms), 202 ms period = 4.950 Hz, each PB14 edge at most 10 us after a PB13 edge. No UART.

circuit: PB13, PB14: logic analyzer / scope probes (no load needed)
